sentences.en: We are anational people, or at least internationalists, and certainly anti-capitalists, international language supporters and Esperantists.
sentences.zh: 我们是无国籍的人，或者说国际主义者，而且肯定是反资本主义的、支持世界语的语言爱好者。

sentences.en: The conference was attended by many internationalists from around the world.
sentences.zh: 会议吸引了来自世界各地的许多国际主义者参加。

sentences.en: She is a committed internationalist who believes in global cooperation and unity.
sentences.zh: 她是一位坚定的国际主义者，相信全球合作与团结。
